name: 10463 · Bronx, NY
findings: ZIP 10463 (Bronx) has 179 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10463 (Bronx) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 4 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10463 (Bronx) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
